speaker: Doctor
text: Given the inability to flex the distal joint and the history of forceful pull, I suspect a mallet finger or flexor digitorum profundus tendon avulsion. REQUEST TEST: Right Ring Finger X-Ray.

text: RESULTS: X-ray_of_the_Right_Hand: No bone fractures or dislocations visible. Soft tissue swelling noted around the distal interphalangeal joint of the right ring finger. speaker: Doctor
text: The X-ray rules out a fracture, and your inability to flex the tip confirms a soft tissue injury, specifically a flexor digitorum profundus tendon avulsion or rupture.
